RAW_M5: NOT_CAPTURED; any raw M5 would be WITHIN_ROTATION_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
delta: C6R minus H; raw logit KL(FP||X); no sampling warpers
final_hidden: existing relative_mse at normalized lm_head input, model-level only
indexing: distribution j predicts saved token[j]; prefill predicts0; j>0 consumes shared[j-1]; t* consumes exactly shared[0:t*)
layer_rule: For each State/Functional family, fixed group-worst region = argmax H_WIN category median regional penalty; ties early/middle/late. Report each sample worst region as well. PRESENT candidate requires >=5/6 H_WIN positive in this same region and <5/6 BOTH_CORRECT positive. Combined PRESENT if any family candidate; MIXED if positive >=5 but common in controls; else NOT_PRESENT. Exploratory only.
next_rule: A only specific layer candidate (C and D each <5/6); B only primary-specific signal without PRESENT layer or QDQ; C if no specific stable signal. QDQ-only specific outcome without an eligible A/B category is protocol category gap: stop and request user direction, never invent verdict.
optional_window_layer_metrics: NOT_CAPTURED; primary LAST64 logit/margin present; all24 state/functional/QDQ captured at t*
primary_rule: KL positive>=5/6 AND median>0; margin negative>=5/6 AND median<0; FH positive>=5/6 AND median>0
qdq_capture: read-only TorchDispatchMode records actual original aten.amax / div scale values; original formal.quantize_c128 called exactly once. CPU exact state and audit parity required before GPU.
qdq_rule: Same regional reduction/group-worst rule; >=5/6 H_WIN positive post-QDQ relative_l2 difference and <5/6 positive in each BOTH_CORRECT and BOTH_WRONG; otherwise MIXED if stable but common, else NOT_PRESENT.
qdq_summary: per layer actual group count/min/mean/median/max; native post-vs-pre QDQ error uses existing state_metric. No copied quantizer, no M5 ranking.
region_reduction: per sample median paired per-layer C6R-H; category median per-sample region penalties
specificity_rule: No active primary/layer/QDQ signal => NOT_PRESENT; PRESENT only an active signal has <5/6 same direction in each C and D; MIXED if any active signal is common in either control category. Raw counts always reported.
state_snapshot: post-QDQ vs FP; functional and logits precede current QDQ
top32: t* only; descending stable logits ties ascending token ID
